item.title: Woman shot by police at Cobb County police headquarters
item.description: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation has been called in to investigate the shooting of a woman by police at the Cobb County Police Department headquarters.The GBI said Cobb County police requested the investigation Wednesday evening. GBI confirmed that Rebekah Patterson, 26, was shot and injured. Investigators said that Patterson entered the headquarters and asked to speak with an officer.
